# Engineer Assessment

Status: candidate product and research program. This repository is the working project workspace. The name is provisional.

## Product question

Can at most three recorded case answers of at most ten minutes each identify later high-performing engineers for a defined role as well as a longer hiring process and better than an equal-time comparator? The first session uses riddles and unusual problems to elicit creativity, analysis and ingenuity; the second tests technical/product design; the third tests cooperation and communication. The answer requires prospective, independent outcomes. No hiring-validity claim exists yet.

The Lab snapshot and its Define v2 packages remain historical evidence; changing this workspace requires a new Lab capture if exact governance evidence is needed.

## First working sequence

1. Prepare a private formative pilot for **mixed software developers** with reviewed cases and provisional feedback across all three sessions.
2. Decide the pilot geography, research, privacy and accessibility protocol before collecting participant recordings.
3. Build a synthetic vertical slice, then the permissioned three-session challenge; evaluate case, rater, transcription, mode and feedback error.
4. Select one engineering role, level, population and future performance criterion for the separate validation program.
5. Run the preregistered role-specific comparison with a longer pipeline and an equal-time method only after the measurement studies support it.

This is a standalone Git workspace with no remote or deployment configured. Lab owner approval, participant collection and employment use are separate decisions.
